messages:
sara: Heads-up: this morning started seeing ~1% 413s from /v1/embeddings for tenant T-42. Root cause looks like mixed small (dim128) + large (dim1024) payloads causing our splitter to miscalculate bytes->units. Anyone seen this before?

jon: @sara can you paste example payload header + response?

sara: here's a repro header and error
```http
POST /v1/embeddings
Content-Type: application/json
X-Embed-Units: 0
Content-Length: 1843
```
Response: 413 Oversize: estimated units 120 > quota shard 100

priya: we don't set X-Embed-Units client-side normally. Is this a client lib bug trying to precompute units?

akshay: runtime currently computes units from bytes and shape hints. If client sends mixed dims in one request splitter attempts to shard by bytes which sometimes underestimates because of per-vector metadata overhead. We need telemetry for per-request dim histogram.

leo: console dashboards only show avg units per route, no dim distribution. That's a blind spot.

marta: agree — add a Tag:embed.dim histogram to our metrics. Also we should log the actual `units_calculated` vs `units_estimate_header` and `splitter_action`.

jon: quick workaround: on the ingress path fallback to byte-based when dim header absent, but if header present prefer header. But if header inconsistent between vectors, fallback to safe worst-case which increases cost.

priya: client use-case: mobile app packs many 128-d summaries with occasional 1024-d references. They expect embedding calls to succeed and be billed correctly. We can't force them to split.

akshay: proposal: runtime change — when mixed dims detected, compute units using per-vector dim + per-vector overhead; add a delta-tag for missing-dim vs mixed-dim; emit metric `embed.splitter.mismatch_count`.

leo: :thumbsup: For console, add a per-tenant panel: `dim distribution`, `oversize rate`, `avg_estimated_units_vs_actual_units`. UX should surface sample payloads for top offenders.

sara: priors: can we do a quick deploy flag to enable 'mixed-dim soft-fail' that instead of 413 will accept and route to slowpath with note in response? Then we can monitor cost delta.

akshay: we can behind flag return 202 with `warning` body and async processing, but many clients expect sync. Better: accept sync but throttle and add header `X-Embed-Route: slowpath` and emit cost_delta metric.

jon: I'll open a PR for telemetry and the flag. Assigning to akshay for runtime change and leo for console panels. @marta can you add the sample-collection logging schema?

marta: on it. I'll add proto: `embed_sample { tenant, dims[], units_calc, header_units, route_taken }` and ship to kafka topic embed-samples-v2.

deploy-bot: deploy started: eng-platform/embedding-sample-logger v2 -> canary

sara: thanks team. let's reconvene after canary metrics (1h). cc: @product (for any customer comms).
